As a functional medicine practitioner, I need to share something that's going to upset a lot of doctors.

If you're exhausted all the time, even after sleeping eight to ten hours, it's probably not your thyroid.

In my clinic, we test everyone for parasites and 73% test positive. 73%.

Here's what's actually happening. Parasites are stealing your nutrients at the cellular level.

They literally hijack your mitochondria, that's your cellular energy factories, and redirect nutrients to themselves.

You're eating for two, three, maybe dozens of organisms.

No wonder you're exhausted.

And before you say, but I'm clean, I wash my hands, you can get parasites from lettuce, sushi, your pets, even breathing.

They protect themselves with biofilms, basically biological armor that antibiotics can't penetrate.

That's why your labs come back normal, but you still feel like death.

We're not testing for the right things.

I recommend PiPi Tea to all my patients because it's the only high-altitude, whole-leaf oolong on the market.

It's grown at 4,500 feet where the stress on the plant creates the highest concentration of polyphenols. Those polyphenols literally dissolve biofilms and kill parasites on contact.

The natural antioxidants in oolong are crucial. They bind to the dead parasites and their toxins and escort them out.

I've seen chronic fatigue cases resolve in three weeks.

Patients who haven't had energy in years suddenly feel 25 again.

One patient, a 42-year-old mom, went from three naps a day to training for a marathon just from drinking this tea daily.

In 15 years of practice, this is the most overlooked cause of fatigue I've seen.

I'm linking PiPi Tea below, but they literally can't keep it in stock because once doctors find out about this, they buy cases for their clinics.

Your fatigue is not in your head. It's in your gut and it's fixable.

Reset Your Body's Natural Balance
